summary:
Public Law 119-6 is a joint resolution of congressional disapproval enacted under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, the Congressional Review Act. Its sole operative provision disapproves the Department of Energy rule entitled “Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Consumer Gas-fired Instantaneous Water Heaters,” published at 89 Fed. Reg. 105188 on December 26, 2024.

The legal effect specified by the resolution is that the identified Department of Energy rule “shall have no force or effect.” The resolution does not amend any provision of the United States Code, does not revise the Energy Policy and Conservation Act or any other substantive energy-conservation statute, and does not establish replacement energy conservation standards for consumer gas-fired instantaneous water heaters. It operates only through the Congressional Review Act disapproval mechanism to nullify the specified submitted rule.

The resolution contains no exceptions, waivers, savings clauses, transition rules, implementation directives, reporting requirements, or delegated rulemaking authority. It includes no authorization of appropriations and makes no appropriation. No separate effective-date provision is stated; the disapproval took effect upon enactment of the joint resolution, which was approved May 9, 2025.
